title: •Master Luke
caption: •Master Luke (V)
game_text: {pilot:2}. During battle, may use 2 Force to place an opponent’s alien (except Jabba or a Rep) present with Luke on owner’s Force Pile (opponent may use or lose 3 Force instead). Immune to attrition < 4 (< 7 if with an alien leader).
lore: Until being reunited with Yoda, Luke suspected that he had completed his training. Has a strong influence on the weak minded.

notes: Unique. Stats POWER 5 / ABILITY 5 / FORCE-SENSITIVE (label only); deploy 5 / forfeit 7. Text opens with the yellow pilot icon + '2.' → {pilot:2} (stub expands 'Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots'). Curly apostrophes in opponent’s / owner’s. Icon column: pilot, warrior. Rebel. Base is the Enhanced Jabba's Palace premium card (expansion ring = Premium-style silver sphere). Lore matches both scans ('weak minded' unhyphenated as printed). Base scan only at 350 px; copyright line is the SE-style form with 1999, read off the 350 scan and confirmed on the 745 V18 remake ('© LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 1999 DECIPHER INC.'). Modern: V18-L-masterluke.gif (745 px, Virtual Set 18 remake); VB3 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
